name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2026-05-25.99.2) introduced by Page MP [Kevin Hogan](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/page/kevin_hogan) (Nationals), which means it was unsuccessful. Mr Hogan [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2026-05-25.99.2): > *The amendments would remove the retrospective application of the bill. The government has introduced this bill with a 1 April 2026 retrospective start date, but we don't have any detail or any explanation of why that date is needed. We're happy to work constructively with the government on these issues, but this is a matter of competition law, and we don't know if there's been a breach of the law that the government is aware of. This amendment would remove the retrospectivity of the law. The amendments would also introduce a sunset clause to the bill. The changes to the bill would sunset on 2 July 2026.
